speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long it has been present? Also, has the numbness and tingling spread to other parts of your hands or body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any itching or tingling sensations that are worse at night, and have you noticed any scaling between your fingers? REQUEST TEST: Skin_Scrape_KOH

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative skin scraping and your occupation, I suspect a parasitic infection like cutaneous larva migrans or strongyloidiasis. REQUEST TEST: Stool_Ova_and_Parasites

speaker: Doctor
text: Since common parasitic and fungal causes have been ruled out, have you noticed any linear, burrow-like tracks on your skin, and have your close contacts or family members developed similar itching symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow and eyelash thinning, and neuropathy strongly suggests Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Slit_Skin_Smear_Acid_Fast

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive acid-fast bacilli smear confirms the diagnosis of Hansen's disease, also known as leprosy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hansen's disease (Leprosy)
